name: prized
description: Give Codex computers in the cloud: it puts your project on a Prized box, a Linux machine that stays on, and keeps working there with your laptop closed, and it runs code, tests and agents in Prized Sandboxes, microVMs that start in seconds. Runs the prized CLI on your computer.

interface.longDescription:
Prized gives your coding agent computers in the cloud. A box is a Linux machine of your own that stays on, so Codex and long jobs keep running after you close your laptop. A sandbox is a Linux microVM that starts in seconds, runs a job and is deleted when the job is done.

With this plugin, Codex uses the prized command-line tool on your computer to:
- start a box, or use one of the boxes on your Prized account
- copy your project to the box once, with no sync, and set Codex up there
- run tests, builds and other long jobs on the box, or hand Codex a task there and walk away
- check on the box and its jobs, read you its rate from Prized's pricing page, and pause, resume, resize or delete a box you name
- run commands, tests and agents in sandboxes, one or many in parallel, and delete them when the job is done
- build sandboxes into your own app with Prized's SDK

You install the prized CLI yourself. Codex asks you before it copies your project or any sign-in, or does anything that costs money, and it never touches a box or a sandbox you did not ask about.

Who it is for: developers who use Codex and want it, their builds and their test runs to keep working on a machine that is always on, or want clean machines to run code they would not run on their own.

Limitations: desktop only. The plugin runs the prized CLI in a local thread, so it needs the ChatGPT desktop app or Codex, and a Prized account. It does not create or control boxes or sandboxes from ChatGPT on the web or on a phone. Boxes and sandboxes run in Prized's cloud and are billed to your Prized account; Codex itself runs on your own ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key.
defaultPrompt: Put this project on a Prized box and run its tests there.
Have Codex fix the failing tests on my Prized box while my laptop is closed.
Run this project's tests in 4 Prized sandboxes in parallel.

publication.release_notes: First release, with two skills. prized-boxes has Codex create a Prized box, copy the project to it once, run long jobs and Codex tasks there, and check on, pause, resume and resize the box. prized-sandboxes has Codex run commands, tests and agents in Prized Sandboxes, one or many in parallel, and delete them when the job is done.
